title: AEON Credit Service outage and unauthorized access, Nov 2026
disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by AEON Credit Service, any government agency, news outlet, company, or anyone else named.
size_basis: One Hong Kong credit card lender. AEON has not said how many customers were affected; its portal and app were down for more than 40 hours.
who_is_affected: AEON credit card customers in Hong Kong, who could not use the online portal and app from Nov 18. AEON says affected customers will be told individually.

known.text: AEON says its system was accessed without authorization.
The portal and app were offline for more than 40 hours from the evening of Nov 18.
AEON hired outside cybersecurity and forensics experts.
AEON says it has found no evidence any data was misused so far.

not_known.text: Whether the intrusion caused the outage.
What data was reached, and how many customers.
How the intruder got in, or who it was.
Whether any regulator is looking into it.
